artifacts.summary: Confirms the cross-phase ceiling-consistency gap in plan-format.md, recommends adding one generalized subsection there plus one advisory-only heuristic check in validate-artifact.sh's existing per-phase loop (option b, no new field, no new script), with (a)-alone and (c)-alone recorded as rejected on their own merits.

memory_candidates.content: validate-artifact.sh's per-phase plan loop (~L303-343) already isolates each phase into a phase_block via mapfile over PHASE_HEADING_ERE line numbers plus sed -n ranges, then regex-extracts a field value from that block. Any new per-phase check (e.g. a numeric Scope Hypothesis estimate) should be a sibling regex read inside this same loop, not a new parsing pass or a new script.

plan-format.md's advisory-first -> promotion-criterion pattern (Verification Tier, Files to modify) always pairs a log_warn in validate-artifact.sh with a named, measured promotion criterion recorded in plan-format.md's Enforcement level subsection (e.g. 'promote once no non-terminal plan under specs/ lacks the field', with the current residue counted). Any new plan-level advisory check should follow this exact shape rather than inventing a new enforcement convention.

This repo's own live plans already cite numeric ceilings in free prose without any format-level support: specs/328.../plans/03_markdown-corpus-consolidation.md runs an ad hoc cumulative 'NET-MD accounting' narrative across phases, and specs/482_create_sapience_extension/plans/01_create-sapience-extension.md cites 'Rule U's 60-line ceiling' and asserts conformance against it. Useful precedent/evidence when generalizing any ceiling-citation rule beyond a single triggering (e.g. Lean longFile) incident.
